activation.timestamp_source: remote UTC clock at receipt creation

arms.wl_graph_static_lr: WL graph plus decision-time static supporting ablation

claim_levels.not_supported: primary paired delta is nonpositive or its run-clustered interval includes zero
claim_levels.supportive_only: primary paired delta is positive but either interval gate fails
claim_levels.strong_positive: primary paired delta run-clustered 95% lower bound is above zero and primary-arm accuracy run-clustered 95% lower bound is above 0.5

effect_analysis_lock.comparison: wl_graph_static_tfidf_lr minus the already-active char_tfidf_lr on identical pairs
effect_analysis_lock.eligibility: finite non-tie external outcome under the unchanged first-960 analysis contract; no arm-specific complete-case deletion
effect_analysis_lock.multiplicity: one primary extension arm and comparator; other three arms are diagnostic only

scope.pre_activation_runs: outcome-unread support only; no method-effect claim
scope.strict_post_activation_runs: only eligible stratum for the fixed primary extension effect
scope.temporal_0812: pre-activation support only; label vault remains sealed
scope.v11_frozen_or_extension: never read by build, activation, or scoring
